{{Top|leg}}
'''Agao-Nir''' was a mining village on [[Bassadro]] located in a dormant volcano range. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in the [[Battle of Bassadro]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Empatojayos Brand]] besieged the range to eliminate the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] forces within it. Brand ordered [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] strikes against the rock formations near the village, removing the Separatists' cover and creating a storm of shrapnel that sliced through Agao-Nir, destroying many of the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] stationed there,<ref name="HNN2">{{InsiderCite|65|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:2:12}}</ref><ref name="CISS">{{InsiderCite|66|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:3:10 Edition}}</ref> as well as four hundred unaffiliated miners.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
